name: Curved Loop
description: Endless text marquee that flows along an SVG path (arc, wave, straight line or full circle), with drag and fling, optional outline, edge fade, separator and scroll-speed boost.
contents: Single SVG text repeated along a path, filling the path length
Optional separator mark between repeats, with its own color
Hidden measuring text used to size the repeat spacing
behavior: Text scrolls endlessly along the path at a constant speed in the chosen direction
Drag with pointer to move the text, release to fling with momentum; fling direction becomes the new scroll direction
Optional scroll boost speeds the loop up while the page or a scroll parent scrolls
Animation pauses when offscreen and stops under prefers-reduced-motion
Remeasures on resize and when fonts finish loading
Component stays hidden until text is measured
editableByProps: Marquee text, separator mark and separator color
Path shape, curve depth, scroll speed and direction
Text color, outline mode, font size, weight, letter spacing and font via className
Edge fade amount, drag interaction, pause on hover, scroll boost

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the wave length or circle ring size
Change the drag fling speed limit
Allow lowercase text instead of uppercase
needsCodeEdit.where: uppercase class on the svg element

needsCodeEdit.change: Remove the full viewport height wrapper
needsCodeEdit.where: min-h-screen class on the root div (jacketRef)

fixed: Root is a div with min-h-screen that centers the svg; it fills at least the viewport height
marqueeText defaults to an empty string, so nothing renders until text is passed
Font is not loaded by the component, supply it with className or page styles
Adds a capture scroll listener on window only when scrollBoost is set, removed on unmount
Viewbox is 1440 by 120 and scales to container width; on narrow screens the text shrinks with it, so a smaller fontSize is advised for mobile
Circle shape sizes the ring from fontSize and needs a wide container

options.look: Text follows a single smooth quadratic curve whose depth is set by curveAmount
options.useWhen: A hero banner needs a gentle sweeping curved ribbon of text

options.look: Text runs along a flat straight line like a classic marquee
options.useWhen: A divider strip between sections or a ticker under the navbar

options.look: Text follows a repeating sine wave with amplitude from curveAmount
options.useWhen: A playful event or music page needs a rippling banner

options.look: Text loops around a full ring that rotates
options.useWhen: A badge or centerpiece spinning text seal in a landing page hero
